method: 20 of 43 programmes, seeded sample (mulberry32, seed 20261030, scripts/audit/sample-dossiers.ts). For each, the stored values and quotes were read against the funder's page as it stands today. Verdicts below are judgements made by reading; the material they were formed from is in hand-check-dossiers.json.
caveat: 20 observations. Proportions below carry Wilson 95% intervals because at this size the interval is wider than the estimate is precise. This sample cannot distinguish a 40% problem from a 60% one.
headline: No fabricated value was found. Every stored value inspected traced to a real sentence on a funder page. The defects are of three other kinds: the catalogue is frozen at August 2026 while funders have moved on, almost half the rows are not open to an Indonesian applicant, and several rows cite a page about something other than the programme.

fabrication.values_inspected_against_a_live_page: all stored quotes on the 16 readable pages
fabrication.note: The quote check is doing its job. See quote-drift.json for the systematic version of this over all 1,732 grounded quotes.
